09STRAIGHT ANSWERS

The questions everyone asks before ordering

Straight answers. If yours isn't here, message us on WhatsApp. A human replies.

Ask a human on WhatsApp ↗
Where does the data actually come from?+

Public B2B sources: LinkedIn, company websites, public directories, and SEC filings for funding data. We don't buy or resell private databases. Lists include LinkedIn profiles, company context and contact details. Business emails go through two verification tools before delivery.

How should we handle privacy and outreach permissions?+

Tell us your target markets and any exclusions before we build your list. Your team is responsible for deciding how to use prospect data under applicable privacy laws and each platform’s rules. We can exclude EU prospects on request. We do not provide legal advice.

Can I order a list for LinkedIn prospecting?+

Yes. Tell us the job titles, seniority, industries, company sizes and locations in your ICP. LinkedIn profile URLs and company details help your team research prospects, plan account-based campaigns and personalise outreach. Share your intended workflow so we can agree the fields before building your sample.

Can you find genuinely niche ICPs?+

Usually. We've built everything from Series B fintech CFOs across DACH to dental practice owners in three specific US states. Send it over, if we can't build it properly we'll say so before you pay, rather than shipping you a padded list.

How fast is delivery, really?+

1,000 leads in about 3 hours. 10,000 in 24 hours. 50,000 in 48 hours. 100,000+ takes 5–7 business days. Average across all orders last week was 18h 24m. Need it faster? Ask, we'll tell you honestly whether it's possible.

Do all leads come with a mobile number?+

No, and anyone promising 100% is guessing. We find publicly available mobiles for roughly 50–60% of rows. The delivered file marks clearly which rows have one, so you're never paying for a blank column.

Why don't you offer tech-stack data?+

We tried it and weren't satisfied with the accuracy available. Shipping a "uses HubSpot" column that's wrong 30% of the time is worse than not shipping it, you'd write campaigns on it. We'll add it when we can stand behind it.

What format do I get, and can I get custom columns?+

Google Sheet or CSV, your choice. Standard columns: First Name, Last Name, Title, Company, Domain, Email, Mobile, HQ Phone, Personal LinkedIn URL, Company LinkedIn URL, Company Size, Industry, Location. Custom columns and per-client file splits are free on request.

What if the list doesn't match what I asked for?+

We rebuild it free or refund you, your call. That's also exactly why the free 100-lead sample exists: you check fit before any money changes hands.

Can I set up recurring monthly delivery?+

Yes, and we'd recommend it if you're sending consistently. Monthly clients get priority in the queue, locked-in pricing, and better rates above 50k/month. No contract, you can stop any month.

Which markets do you cover?+

US, UK, Canada, Australia and the EU, for English-language outreach. We can pull names and companies from most countries, but the file is delivered in English-language format.

Is there a contract or minimum?+

Neither. Order once and never come back, genuinely fine. No auto-renew, no minimum spend, no notice period.
